comments.body: When `decompress z` returns `Error.unimplemented`, this branch falls through to the vendored check and can return `PASS`. That reports an unchecked oracle roundtrip as passed, contrary to the task requirement that any case whose oracle function returns `Error.unimplemented` be skipped. Return `SKIP` here (or otherwise retain that status after the vendored check).

last.summary: The vectors regenerate byte for byte and the checked upstream behaviors match the fixtures. Please fix compression-case accounting: an unimplemented oracle decompressor currently allows a compression case to pass without an oracle roundtrip.
